display.purpose: Page/hero titles and scoreboard headers. Saira Condensed, uppercase; italic reserved for the primary CTA only.

title.purpose: Nav links, button labels, table headers. Saira Condensed, uppercase, tracked.

body.purpose: Prose and helper text. Saira, regular. Cap measure at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Spline Sans Mono. Every micro-label and every comparable number; tabular by nature.

motion.name: ease-color
motion.purpose: Fast (~150ms) color-only transitions for hover/active. No layout animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one true action per view (e.g. SAVE ROSTER). Solid IMSA red, condensed uppercase.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:44px; padding:0 20px; background:#e10600; color:#fff; font-family:'Saira Condensed',sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; font-style:italic; letter-spacing:0.05em; text-transform:uppercase; border:none; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#ff2d2d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ff5d5d; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost action; hairline border, condensed uppercase, aligned to primary height.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:44px; padding:0 20px; background:transparent; color:#c8ccd2; font-family:'Saira Condensed',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; border:1px solid #2a2d33; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#3a3f47; color:#fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ff5d5d; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Card / Panel
components.description: Primary content panel on the void. Flat at rest; separation is the hairline border.
components.html:
YOUR PICKS
Build a roster under the salary cap before qualifying.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#101317; border:1px solid #1f242a; border-radius:6px; padding:16px; transition:border-color .15s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:#2a2d33; } .ds-card-title { font-family:'Saira Condensed',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff; } .ds-card-body { margin-top:8px; font-family:'Saira',sans-serif; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; color:#c8ccd2; }

components.name: Data Input
components.description: Recessed near-black well with mono value text; reads like a data field.
components.css: .ds-input { height:48px; width:240px; padding:0 15px; background:#070809; color:#fff; font-family:'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.1em; border:1px solid #2a2d33; border-radius:4px; outline:none; transition:border-color .15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#3a3f47; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#3a3f47; outline:2px solid #ff5d5d; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Mono micro-label on a tinted wash of its own semantic hue; color is always paired with a dot + text.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; height:20px; padding:0 8px; background:rgba(255,194,61,0.10); border:1px solid rgba(255,194,61,0.35); border-radius:3px; } .ds-pill-dot { width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:9999px; background:#ffc23d; } .ds-pill { font-family:'Spline Sans Mono',monospace; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:0.06em; color:#ffc23d; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Pure-black broadcast bar with a 2px IMSA-red bottom edge; condensed uppercase links, active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; height:64px; padding:0 26px; background:#000; border-bottom:2px solid #e10600; } .ds-nav-link { display:flex; align-items:center; height:44px; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; font-family:'Saira Condensed',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8a8f98; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:color .15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:#c8ccd2; } .ds-nav-active { color:#fff; border-bottom-color:#e10600; }

components.name: Broadcast Slash
components.description: Skewed red leading accent — the angular motion mark of broadcast motorsport graphics. Deliberate punctuation, not on every heading.
components.css: .ds-slash-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; } .ds-slash { width:6px; height:28px; background:#e10600; transform:skewX(-14deg); } .ds-slash-label { font-family:'Saira Condensed',sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff; }

narrative.overview: IMSA Fantasy looks like a live broadcast timing-and-scoring graphics package, executed with the restraint of a premium motorsport marque. The surface is a near-black void; content rides on it as crisp, slightly-elevated panels. The numbers - positions, prices, points, deltas - are the heroes, set in a tabular monospace so they align and scan like a timing screen. IMSA red is the single brand voice, spent sparingly on the things that matter. It is broadcast-fluent but never cluttered: generous gutters, clear hierarchy, one accent at a time. The result reads as precise, fast, premium - the focus of the grid before lights-out, not the noise of a casino floor.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black broadcast canvas; content as crisp elevated panels, not floating cards.
Monospace numerals treated as first-class typography - the data IS the interface.
One accent (IMSA red) spent deliberately; racing-class colors reserved strictly for wayfinding.
Tight, engineered corners (2-8px) and hairline borders over heavy shadow.
Premium restraint: breathing room and hierarchy carry weight, not noise.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: IMSA red is the only brand accent and appears on <=10% of any screen - the primary action, the live state, the nav bar. If two reds compete on a screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Class-Color Reserve
rules.body: GTP/LMP2/GTD PRO/GTD hues signify racing class and nothing else. Never borrow a class color for a button, a status, or decoration. Class is wayfinding; spending it elsewhere breaks the map.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every number a player compares - position, price, points, delta - is set in Spline Sans Mono so columns align to the digit. Proportional numerals in a standings table are forbidden.

rules.name: The Italic-Restraint Rule
rules.body: Display italic is loud. Use it only on the primary CTA. Everywhere else, weight and case carry emphasis - not slant.

rules.name: The Flat-Void Rule
rules.body: In-page surfaces never cast shadows. Depth at rest is tonal layering plus a lightening border. A shadow on a card is a 2014 tell; if a panel looks like it's floating, flatten it.

dos: Do set every comparable number (position, price, points, delta) in Spline Sans Mono, tabular - columns align to the digit.
Do keep IMSA red to <=10% of any screen: the primary action, the live state, the nav edge.
Do reserve GTP/LMP2/GTD PRO/GTD colors strictly for racing-class wayfinding, and always pair class/status color with text, icon, or position so it survives color-blindness.
Do convey depth with the tonal surface ramp + lightening hairline borders; keep in-page surfaces flat.
Do lead with breathing room - the premium register comes from generous gutters and clear hierarchy, not added ornament.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard - no cream/light surfaces, no identical icon-heading-text card grids, no big-number hero-metric template.
Don't drift toward the DraftKings betting aesthetic - no loud green-on-black, no odds-board clutter, no flashing CTAs or manufactured urgency.
Don't replicate cluttered timing software - density only where it earns its keep; never data-dump for its own sake.
Don't go toy or cartoonish - no mascots, no bubbly pill-rounded everything, no childish gamification. Corners stay tight (2-8px).
Don't use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or rows.
Don't spend display italic or full-red beyond the single primary action per view.
Don't drop shadows on resting in-page surfaces - shadow is reserved for true overlays.
